integrity: Stationary construction, exact spectral derivation, global analytic bound, critical analytic expansion and reproducible numerical checks; published correlation and transfer formulas explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Single inhibitory discrete delay, symmetric binary flips, c>h>0, T>0. A nonzero global peak is guaranteed for every supercritical delay, but uniqueness is asserted only sufficiently near onset. No claim of independent mathematical validation or publication priority.
title: Sharp spectral-peak onset in inhibitory delayed telegraph noise
